# Mask Image

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Masks an image.

## Syntax

~~~~text
maskImage(image: <#Variable#>, mode: <#Enumeration (WFMaskType)#>, mask: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
maskImage(image: ShortcutInput, mode: Icon, mask: Clipboard)
~~~~
